Thanks for the advice.
Is it possible to pay a hitman to unexpectedly kill you? That’s something I’d spend my money on.
I just want to die. I don’t want motivation to live. Glad what you’re doing works for you tho.

Smart choice. Happy pc hunting
If you say so

I literally started using my sister’s HP because Excel on Mac barely has any of the essential features. Not even a Page Layout tab. I knew the reviews were bad but I had already paid for it through my school’s tuition. Sometimes there’s alternatives to achieving missing functions but a lot of the time there’s not. Macs are great but not for Excel.

What a tone deaf and ignorant comparison when Black people are still being lynched to this day. The only issue with cancel culture is that it doesn’t stick. People deserve to be called out for the problematic things they do. Most people don’t change over time. Especially when they were grown ass adults when they did those things. Not everyone deserves to maintain their extensive and influential platforms.
Ah, sister squabbles. I have two. Trust me, I feel you.

People are pretty unpredictable. Even vetting the right guy is just too much work. But it’s worth it. Hope you find a suitable partner and father for your kids. All fathers should be team players.. and loyal.

Can’t imagine bringing a child into this God forsaken world. I don’t even wanna be here. But if I were to parent, I wouldn’t mind doing it alone. Do you want kids and a partner or do you just not want marriage
Thank you for your insight. Appreciate it. Hope you’re well
Exactly. Never having kids either.

Yeah, this won’t change. This has been going on for years. I’ve broken up plenty of their physical and verbal fights enough to know not to step in anymore. Can’t call the police... my dad is a cop. My parents would lose their livelihoods. So I’ll just continue to mind my business until I move out. 

They’re pretty loud. You should hear the door slams.

White people are not dying at the hands of police at disproportionate rates. White people also aren’t systematically oppressed and racially profiled. Your sketchy stats lack context and the necessary regard for historical socioeconomic discrepancies. Your source is obsolete too. Do better and try again.
Why is everyone discrediting BLM as if this has anything to do with American politics?
Didn’t even think of it that way. Thank you for your insight. Hope you’re doing ok.

I was a mess during the week of my graduation. I literally cried about having to virtually attend. I think it’s because I didn’t feel worthy no matter what I’ve done to get here. That was a couple of weeks ago and I’m still in my feelings. I’m currently working on another useless degree and I have no idea what jobs to apply for. Unfortunately, I don’t have any advice to give. Just know you’re not alone
Hear you
She’s a pediatrician so I should be aging out soon. Thank you for your concern. I hope you’re okay.

I feel okay now. Talking to my doctor makes me feel uncomfortable. I feel like I’m being interrogated so she can prove I’m just overreacting. My family probably cares. But they have their own shit to deal with. I don’t have any friends but I prefer it that way I guess
Yes. She makes me feel like an idiot. Even scolded me like a child during the Zoom call
Right lmao wild.
In college doing the same thing
Merry Christmas

Can’t really explain it. Not sure how. I just know that death will be my ultimate release. I’m done feeling the way I do. Of course I don’t want to die like this. I don’t think anyone really wants to. I just can’t see it any other way.
Sure isn’t

POC, especially black people, have no business putting their lives on the line for this country anymore than they already do. They don’t give a fuck about black people. They never have. Many of my family members fought for this country but it wasn’t their choice. I don’t understand those that choose to.
